property_summary: For any caller and any uint _val, if the contract is not initialized then SetMinSum(_val) on the reference always succeeds and sets MinSum to _val; the mutant wrongly rejects inputs with _val < 1 ether causing SetMinSum to revert for some fuzzed _val values.
change_summary: Add a require that _val must be at least 1 ether, preventing MinSum from being set below that value.
